ru.title: Предостережение от обмана | Иисус Христос
ru.description:
Лжехристы и лжепророки могут ввести в заблуждение даже самых верных. Эта цитата Иисуса напоминает нам о важности бдительности в вере. В мире, полном ложных учений и искушений, мы должны оставаться на страже и исследовать Писание. Как вы распознаете истину среди обмана? Какие признаки лжеучителей вы замечали в своей жизни?

en.title: Warning: False Prophets Will Deceive | Jesus Christ
en.description:
Are you aware of the warnings about false prophets? This quote from Jesus Christ reminds us that even the most devoted can be misled by deceptive signs and wonders. In today's world, where misinformation spreads rapidly, discerning truth from deception is crucial for our faith. 

Jesus cautions us to stay vigilant and grounded in His Word. By doing so, we can protect ourselves from being swayed by those who misrepresent the truth. Reflect on your own understanding—are you prepared to recognize and resist deception? 

What do you think it takes to discern true prophecy from false? 

#Shorts #Christianity #Bible #Faith #Discernment #Truth #Deception #Prophecy #SpiritualAwakening #Jesus #Warning #JesusChrist #Faithful #Vigilance
en.first_comment: Jesus' warning about false prophets is more relevant than ever. In a world filled with conflicting messages, how do we remain anchored in truth? Reflecting on our own faith can help us stay vigilant. Let’s explore this together! Don’t forget to subscribe for more insights.
